ProjectMetadata.Name: UBB-SE-2026-MovieApp
ProjectMetadata.Description: Unified movie management and social platform created by merging Team 927/1 and Team 925/1 (incorporating PureCaffeine features).
ProjectMetadata.ArchitectureType: Feature-Based Layout for UI/Logic, and Clean Architecture Layers (DataLayer, Logic, Web, WebApi, Proxy)

Rule.name: Spaces for indentation
Rule.Expected: Use space indentation, exactly 4 spaces. No tabs allowed.
Rule.CodebaseStatus: Fully Compliant (Enforced by StyleCop SA1027 and .editorconfig).

Rule.name: End file with newline
Rule.Expected: Every file must end with a trailing newline character.
Rule.CodebaseStatus: Fully Compliant (Enforced by StyleCop SA1518 and .editorconfig).

Rule.name: Use CRLF line endings
Rule.Expected: Windows-style CRLF (carriage return + line feed) endings throughout.

Rule.name: Strip trailing whitespace
Rule.Expected: No trailing whitespace allowed at the end of lines.
Rule.CodebaseStatus: Fully Compliant (Enforced by StyleCop SA1028 and .editorconfig trim_trailing_whitespace = true).

Rule.name: UTF-8 Encoding
Rule.Expected: All files must use UTF-8 character encoding.

Rule.name: PascalCase for types, members, methods
Rule.Expected: Classes, Structs, Enums, Interfaces, Methods, Properties, Events, Delegates named in PascalCase.

Rule.name: Interface prefix with I
Rule.Expected: Interface names must start with a capital 'I' followed by PascalCase.

Rule.name: Static fields naming prefix
Rule.Expected: Static fields prefixed with 's_' followed by camelCase.

Rule.name: Private fields naming prefix
Rule.Expected: Private/private-protected instance fields prefixed with '_' followed by camelCase.
Rule.CodebaseStatus: Compliant (Note: StyleCop SA1309 is set to "None" to permit the underscore prefix).

Rule.name: camelCase for parameters and local variables
Rule.Expected: Plain camelCase naming with no prefixes for parameters and local variables.

Rule.name: Banned var keyword
Rule.Expected: Never use 'var' - always write explicit types.
Rule.CodebaseStatus: NON-COMPLIANT (DOCS OUT OF DATE). The actual codebase contains hundreds of occurrences of the 'var' keyword across controllers, logic services, viewmodels, and data seeders. The .editorconfig has csharp_style_var_* = false:warning set, which causes compiler warnings in modern build environments but the rule is ignored in the existing code files.

Rule.name: Language keywords over BCL names
Rule.Expected: Use keywords (int, string, bool) instead of BCL types (Int32, String, Boolean).

Rule.name: Null-coalescing operators
Rule.Expected: Use ?? and ??= instead of manual null checks in assignments.

Rule.name: Null-conditional operator
Rule.Expected: Use ?. instead of nested null checks.

Rule.name: Pattern matching over is-checks + cast
Rule.Expected: Use switch expressions and pattern matching (is Type variable, is not null).

Rule.name: Ternary expressions
Rule.Expected: Use ternary operator (?:) for simple assignments and returns instead of if-else.

Rule.name: Collection initializers
Rule.Expected: Initialize collections inline using braces or collection expressions instead of sequential Add() calls.

Rule.name: Object initializers
Rule.Expected: Set object properties inline at instantiation instead of sequential assignments.

Rule.name: Explicit access modifiers
Rule.Expected: Every non-interface member must carry an explicit access modifier (public, private, etc.).

Rule.name: Readonly fields
Rule.Expected: Mark fields readonly whenever possible (assigned only in constructor).

Rule.name: Expression bodies rule
Rule.Expected: Use expression bodies (=>) for properties, getters/setters, indexers. Methods and constructors MUST use full block bodies with braces.

Rule.name: Static local and anonymous functions
Rule.Expected: Local functions and lambdas that do not capture instance state should be declared static.

Rule.name: Braces for control-flow blocks
Rule.Expected: Always use curly braces for if, else, loops, etc., even for single-line blocks.
Rule.CodebaseStatus: Compliant (Enforced by StyleCop SA1503 and .editorconfig csharp_prefer_braces = true:warning).

Rule.name: Allman brace layout style
Rule.Expected: Opening braces placed on their own line. else, catch, finally start on a new line.
Rule.CodebaseStatus: Compliant (Enforced by StyleCop SA1500 and .editorconfig csharp_new_line_* = true).

Rule.name: Block-scoped namespace declaration
Rule.Expected: Namespaces must be declared using the block-scoped layout with curly braces (not file-scoped).

Project.name: MovieApp
Project.Description: Client application built with WinUI 3 (Windows App SDK). Uses a feature-based folder structure under Features/.

Folder.name: Auth
Folder.description: User authentication pages and state management.

Folder.name: Assets
Folder.description: Images, icons, and visual assets.

Folder.name: Properties
Folder.description: Launch settings and configuration.

Folder.name: Events
Folder.description: Local screening events view, schedule, and ticket purchasing.

Folder.name: Inventory
Folder.description: List of user's owned movies and purchased event tickets.

Folder.name: Marketplace
Folder.description: Flea market equipment list, detail, and transaction initiation.

Folder.name: MovieCatalog
Folder.description: Grid/list view of the central movie database.

Folder.name: MovieDetail
Folder.description: Detailed movie page, displaying reviews and screening events.

Folder.name: MovieSwipe
Folder.description: Tinder-like swiping feature for setting movie preferences.

Folder.name: MovieTournament
Folder.description: Tournament game setup, match pairings, and leaderboard tracking.

Folder.name: PersonalityMatch
Folder.description: Computes personality matching compatibility with other users.

Folder.name: ReelsEditing
Folder.description: Short video cropping and background music editing.

Folder.name: ReelsFeed
Folder.description: Infinite-scroll reels feed with player and like/interaction triggers.

Folder.name: ReelsUpload
Folder.description: Video file upload and movie linking interface.

Folder.name: TrailerScraping
Folder.description: Trailer video background scraper logs dashboard.

Folder.name: Wallet
Folder.description: Display and top-up of user balance.

Folder.name: Shared
Folder.description: Common custom controls, dialogs, styles, and templates.

File.description: Application entry point; configures Dependency Injection (DI) services.
Main frame shell with NavigationView menu.
Navigation logic for loading feature pages in the frame.

Project.name: MovieApp.DataLayer
Project.Description: Data access layer containing Entity Framework Core DbContext, DB model declarations, and repository implementations.

Folder.name: Models
Folder.description: Database entities mapped to SQL Server tables.

Folder.name: Interfaces
Folder.description: Repository interface contracts (e.g. IMovieRepository).

Folder.name: Repositories
Folder.description: Concrete repository implementations performing database operations via DbContext.

File.description: Seeds the database with movies, users, event schedules, and demo interactions.
Represents the Users table (credentials, balance, roles).
Represents short videos linked to movies and creators.
Stores swipe/tournament preference scores between users and movies.
Stores aggregated user statistics and analytics.
Stores discount sales applied to movies.

Project.name: MovieApp.Logic
Project.Description: Business logic layer containing validation, calculation engines, and service wrappers around repositories.

Folder.name: Services
Folder.description: Common domain services (e.g. AudioLibraryService, ReviewService).

Folder.name: Interfaces
Folder.description: Service contracts exposed to UI and Controllers.

Folder.name: Features
Folder.description: Feature-specific business logic matching the UI modules.

Folder.name: Helpers
Folder.description: Utility methods.

Project.name: MovieApp.Proxy
Project.Description: API gateway proxy services that communicate with MovieApp.WebApi. Used by the WinUI 3 app to delegate logic execution to the server.

Folder.name: Services
Folder.description: Proxy services matching the WebApi controllers (e.g. MovieProxyService).

File.description: Underlying HTTP client wrapper handling token headers and requests.

Project.name: MovieApp.WebApi
Project.Description: ASP.NET Core REST API. Serves as the database interface for the Proxy layer.

Folder.name: AppDbContext
Folder.description: EF Core database context configuration.

Folder.name: Endpoints
Folder.description: Controller classes mapping routes under api/... (e.g. MovieEndpointsController).

Folder.name: DTOs
Folder.description: Request/Response data transfer objects.

Folder.name: Auth
Folder.description: JWT authentication handlers.

File.description: WebApi entry point; sets up middleware, controllers routing, and DB connection.

Project.name: MovieApp.Web
Project.Description: Web frontend built on ASP.NET Core MVC. Implements features for user reviews, catalog browsing, and video players.

Folder.name: Controllers
Folder.description: MVC controller classes (e.g., CatalogController, ReelsEditingController).

Folder.name: Views
Folder.description: Razor templates for web layout and pages.

Folder.name: Models
Folder.description: MVC view models.

Project.name: MovieApp.WebDTOs
Project.Description: Shared DTO models used for serialization between Web, WebApi, and Proxy projects.
